В топологии видны ноды, порты, роли mast.en: Topology shows nodes, ports, master/replica roles and reachability. The selected instance offers statistics, clients, ACL, configuration, Slowlog and Latency, plus Redis and Sentinel consoles with command hints.

Поддерживаются одиночные Redis, репликац.en: Standalone Redis, replication, Sentinel and Redis Cluster are supported.
